verdict.rationale: DBOS's Conductor API/CLI mentions managing 'members, roles, and API keys' and dbosctl managing API keys, implying some access-control primitives, but there is no documentation of issuing scoped/least-privilege credentials specifically for an AI agent's use of external APIs or tools. Missing for 10: explicit scoped-credential issuance workflow, per-agent least-privilege token minting, and any documentation tying API keys to agent identity or permission scoping.
